'''Ash's hat''' (Japanese: '''サトシのぼうし''' ''Satoshi's hat'') is an [[Ash's clothing|item of clothing]] that [[Ash Ketchum]] is seldom seen without. Throughout ''[[Pokémon the Series]]'', Ash has worn seven different hats, one for each of the seven different series.

All of Ash's hats have been produced for people to wear. Ash's ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' hat was available to purchase at [[Pokémon Center (store)#Online|PokémonCenter.com]] before it shut down. His hats can be found at numerous stores (including the Pokémon Centers in Japan) and on online auction sites such as {{wp|eBay}}.

==In animation==
===Pokémon League Expo hat===
Ash's first hat, worn during the [[original series]], is easily the most well-known: an official [[Pokémon League]] Expo hat that was red and white with a green, stylized  "L" on the front. There were only 100 of these hats which were given away by the Pokémon League, and Ash claims to have "sent in about a million postcards" in order to obtain it. {{an|Misty}} also tried to win it but stated she only sent in one postcard. Interestingly, [[Duplica]] also owns one of these hats, as she was shown wearing it while she was imitating Ash. Ash wore this hat during his journey through [[Kanto]], the [[Orange Islands]], and [[Johto]], and was very attached to it, becoming enraged when {{AP|a Mankey|Primeape}} stole it and played keep-away with it in ''[[EP025|Primeape Goes Bananas]]''. The design may be loosely based on {{ga|Red}}'s Generation I hat, and in early concept sketches for the animated series, Ash's hat matched Red's exactly.

Commonly, Ash would turn the cap backwards, particularly when he was concentrating heavily, such as when he would face a {{pkmn|Trainer}} or capture a Pokémon. This was seen most often early in his journey in Kanto, gradually becoming less frequent until his journey in Johto ended, by which time he hardly ever turned his cap. The sequence was actually a common animation practice used to cut costs at the time.

{{AP|Pikachu}} briefly wore Ash's hat in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]''.

===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' hat===
After returning from Johto, Ash was given a change of clothes by [[Delia Ketchum|his mother]], and he immediately changed into them, including switching his old hat for a new black-and-red one which had a green {{i|Poké Ball}} symbol on it. He seemed to have no hesitation in changing hats, despite the attachment shown in ''[[EP025|Primeape Goes Bananas]]''.

Like the first one, his second hat was also stolen by a monkey-like Pokémon which Ash later captured, this time an {{AP|Aipom}} in ''[[AG179|Slaking Kong!]]''. Unlike previous occasions, Ash actually accepted that it was gone (or so he assumed), saying that he would "feel strange" without it. At the end of the episode, Aipom returned Ash's hat to him. However, Aipom followed Ash and {{ashfr}} to the Kanto Grand Festival where she stole his hat again. After Ash captured her, Aipom stole Ash's hat multiple more times as ''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire'' ended and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' began.

Ash rarely flipped his hat during the series. Occasions on which he flipped his hat include when he was dressed as an eggplant in ''[[AG104|Claydol Big and Tall]]'', when he was cleaning the [[Fighting Dojo]] in ''[[AG145|Pasta La Vista!]]'', while he was sleeping with his Pokémon in ''[[AG189|Gathering the Gang of Four!]]'', and during the climax of the [[M09|ninth Pokémon movie]].

Although it does not directly appear in any episode, Pikachu is shown wearing Ash's hat in the [[title card]]s of the Battle Frontier arc from ''[[AG134|A Real Cleffa Hanger]]'' to ''[[AG192|Home is Where the Start Is!]]''.

===''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' hat===
Ash had received his third hat in a package from his mother while in the [[Sinnoh]] region. Though his clothes changed quite a bit between their ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' iterations, his hat remained similar; though while his second hat had a green Poké Ball symbol, his third one was blue. This hat also had a larger and square black area around the Poké Ball, while the black area in ''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire'' was round. <!-- Which Pokémon has stolen this hat and when? -->

Ash flipped this hat only twice: in his battle against {{si|Tobias}} in ''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'' and briefly in the [[M13|thirteenth Pokémon movie]].

For lessons of the [[Pokémon Learning League]] set in the Sinnoh region, Ash's hat was simply his Hoenn hat but with the Poké Ball symbol recolored blue.

In ''[[DP009|Setting the World on its Buneary!]]'', Pikachu retrieved Ash's hat after {{AP|Aipom}} stole it and ran off, causing it to briefly fall on Pikachu's head.

===''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'' hat===
In ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', Ash wore a red and off-white hat. Unlike the hats seen during ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', this hat bore a slight resemblance to the one seen in the [[original series]], but with a blue {{i|Poké Ball}} design for a logo and no line running down the middle. The hat resembles the hat worn by {{ga|Hilbert}} from {{game|Black and White|s}}.

In ''[[BW020|Dancing With the Ducklett Trio!]]'', Ash's hat was stolen once again, this time by a trio of {{p|Ducklett}}.

During the early episodes of ''Pokémon the Series: Black & White'', Ash flipped his hat somewhat often, with decreasing frequency as the series went on. This is the same pattern seen in the original series with the Pokémon League Expo hat. In ''[[BW121|Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!]]'', Ash flipped his hat before moving forward to help his Pokémon dig through the cave wall.

In ''[[BW006|Dreams by the Yard Full!]]'', Pikachu temporarily wore Ash's hat to protect himself from the [[Dream Mist]] spreading across [[Striaton City]].

===''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' hat===
In ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', Ash wears a red hat with a white brim and a white semicircle across the front. This hat resembles the hat worn by {{ga|Red}} in [[core series|the games]] from {{game|FireRed and LeafGreen|s}} to {{B2W2}}.

Once again, his hat was stolen in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream]]'' where [[Serena's Pancham|a mischievous Pancham]] stole it, along with {{an|Clemont}}'s glasses, to use for practicing for performances. {{an|Serena}} eventually got the two items back by trading for a pair of sunglasses.

Ash flipped his hat somewhat often early in ''Pokémon the Series: XY'', but only did so twice in the second half of the series: during the [[M18|eighteenth Pokémon movie]] and in ''[[XY116|The Synchronicity Test!]]''. Ash also had the tendency of adjusting his hat often in this series; this was seen more commonly than him flipping his hat backwards. This tendency echoes Red's sprite animations from {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}} onwards.

Although it does not directly appear in any episode, Pikachu is shown wearing Ash's hat in the Japanese opening [[Mad-Paced Getter]].

===''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'' hat===
In ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', Ash wears a red hat with a white Poké Ball symbol on it. The hat resembles {{ga|Elio}}'s hat from [[Pokémon Sun and Moon]], but is red instead of black while the brim is recolored from black to white.

The hat continued the tradition of being stolen, this time by {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Koko}} in ''[[SM002|The Guardian's Challenge]]'', where it stole the hat to lure Ash and Pikachu to a forest to battle against them, returning the hat when they arrived. Ash's hat was left behind during a time travel accident with a {{OBP|Celebi|recurring}} in ''[[SM125|A Timeless Encounter!]]'', which took Ash and his {{AP|Torracat}} back to [[Melemele Island]] in the time of {{an|Professor Kukui}}'s youth. In ''[[SM126|Pikachu's Exciting Adventure!]]'', which takes place during Ash's disappearance, Ash's remaining Pokémon took turns wearing his hat while looking for him.

Ash flipped his hat more often in ''Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon'' than in the early episodes of most other series. Whenever he used {{m|10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt}}, Ash had Pikachu wear his hat before performing the [[Z-Move]].

===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' hat===
In ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', Ash wears a red hat. It has a black C shape on its front, resembling a Poké Ball.

Ash flipped his hat four times in the series: in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'' while he and [[Goh]] were sand-boarding across [[Desert Resort]], in ''[[JN057|Memories of a Warming Kindness!]]'' while he and Goh were at a ramen restaurant, in ''[[JNS04|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 4)]]'' while he, Goh, and {{an|Dawn}} were rescuing a {{p|Heatran}}, and in ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'' during the climax of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] finals.

When he is using {{m|10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt}}, Ash has Pikachu wear his hat before performing the [[Z-Move]]. In ''[[JN142|The Same Moon, Now and Forever!]]'', Pikachu wore Ash's hat for most of the episode after he was separated from Ash by {{TRT}}.

===Alternate {{pkmn|movie}} continuity hat===
In ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', the {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} of the [[I Choose You! trilogy|alternate continuity]] is shown wearing a different hat. It looks almost the same as the other Ash's original Pokémon League Expo hat, except that the Pokémon League logo is changed to resemble the Poké Ball symbol from his ''Sun & Moon'' hat. Ash continued wearing this hat in ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]'' and ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'', despite the rest of his outfit changing. This makes it the only one of Ash's hats that was worn with multiple outfits.

In ''I Choose You!'', Ash wore this hat backwards twice, both times while protecting {{AP|Pikachu|Pikachu (M20)}}. In ''The Power of Us'', Ash wore this hat backwards when Pikachu battled {{p|Zeraora}}.

Pikachu momentarily wore Ash's hat in ''I Choose You!'' as he emerged from his {{i|Poké Ball}}.

Due to its shorter screentime, this is Ash's first hat that has never been stolen by a Pokémon in any of its appearances. Instead, Ash gave it away to a {{p|Mankey}} after retrieving a hat stolen from {{OBP|Sunny|JNS05}} in ''[[JNS05|Distant Blue Sky!]]''. Ash received a new hat from [[Ash's father|his father]], which is the same Pokémon League Expo hat Ash wears in the main continuity.

==In the games==
[[File:USUM Hero Cap f.png|thumb|200px|A model of the Hero's Cap from {{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}]]
===Core series games===
====For players====
In [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]], the player, regardless of their selected [[gender]], can purchase a "[[Fashion item|Hero's Cap]]" in [[Malie City]]'s Community Center. This cap is a replica of Ash's hat from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''.

In the [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]] [[Pokémon Sword and Shield Expansion Pass|Expansion Pass]], the player, regardless of their selected [[gender]], can receive a "Partner Cap" from a {{tc|Scientist}} at the [[Isle of Armor]] train station in the [[Fields of Honor]] by talking to her while owning a {{p|Zarude}}. The hat is based on Ash's hat in the ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'' movie series.

====[[Event Pokémon]]====
{{bulbanews|Cap Pikachu, Pikashunium Z to be available in Japan}}
{{main|Pikachu in a cap}}
Six [[Pikachu variants|forms]] of {{p|Pikachu}}, each wearing one of Ash's six hats between the original series and ''Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon'', were introduced in [[Pokémon Sun and Moon]]. They were distributed to moviegoers who pre-ordered tickets to ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'' in Japan, and via a series of internet downloads in the West. A seventh form, the Partner Cap Pikachu, wearing Ash's hat from ''I Choose You!'', was introduced in [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]]. It was available via a special [[Pokémon Ga-Olé]] disc in Japan, and via a QR code distributed at screenings of the movie in the West. An eighth form, World Cap Pikachu, wearing Ash's hat from ''Pokémon Journeys: The Series'', was distributed to [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]].

Pikachu in a Cap have also appeared in spin-off games, such as {{pkmn|GO}}, {{pkmn|Shuffle}}, {{pkmn|Masters EX}}, {{pkmn|Tretta}}, {{pkmn|Ga-Olé}}, and {{pkmn|Mezastar}}.
{{-}}

===Spin-off games===

====Hey You, Pikachu!====
[[File:Ash hat Hey You Pikachu.png|200px|thumb|Ash's hat in Hey You, Pikachu]]
In [[Hey You, Pikachu!]], the original hat, along with the rest of the outfit, can be seen hanging on a coat rack in the player's bedroom. Pikachu also uses the hat in "The Piñata Game" to cover his eyes.
{{-}}

====Pokémon Trading Card Game Live====
[[File:Classic Trainer Trucker Hat TCG Live.png|thumb|The Classic Trainer Trucker Hat]]
In [[Pokémon Trading Card Game Live]], the original hat is available for players to wear. It is called the '''Classic Trainer Trucker Hat''', and it can be purchased for 350 {{DL|Pokémon Trading Card Game Live|Currency|Coin}}s. It is a little different from the hat as depicted in the television show, being a reskin of the various Trucker Hat items. Therefore, the Classic Trainer Trucker Hat does not have the same texture as the original, and the opening in the back is missing.
{{-}}

* In ''[[EP037|Ditto's Mysterious Mansion]]'', [[Duplica]] is shown to own a hat that appears to be identical to Ash's Pokémon League Expo hat.
* According to the ''[[Pokémon Visual Guide]]'' and its sequels, Ash obtained the Pokémon League Expo hat by mailing in cereal box tops. In ''[[EP025|Primeape Goes Bananas]]'', Ash says he had to send in a million "postcards" in order to obtain it.
